Why removal is the honest fix

A genuine head swap (pig head seamlessly placed) still reads STICKER — the signatures are structural (donor material, face below the graft). Under the judge's ontology a visible merge is never one animal, so the only repair it recognizes is removing the merge. Negative control: clean bunny input → R1 reads ONE_ANIMAL → PASS with zero rounds, REMOVE_GRAFT never proposed.
